vz_breakdown_each_bar_multiplies_the_hit: Each bar multiplies the hit, and each gridline doubles it, so a ×2 is the same size wherever it sits and a cut runs the other way. The result compares against a hit from base {stat} alone, because the talent multiplier depends on the attack.
vz_breakdown_spread_and_aggravate_add_a_: Spread and Aggravate add a flat chunk from level and EM alone. The chunk then rides the rest of the hit, so it crits and takes DMG Bonus like the hit does.
vz_breakdown_damage_from_level_and_em_al: Damage from level and EM alone, so the result is a number. For most characters, crit, ATK, and DMG% do nothing, and enemy DEF doesn’t apply.
vz_breakdown_damage_from_level_and_em_wi: Damage from level and EM, with two brackets of its own: Base DMG Bonus and Elevation. It can crit, and enemy DEF doesn’t apply. These figures are the top contributor’s 60% share.
vz_breakdown_the_hit_s_damage_formula_on: The hit's damage formula, one column per bracket
vz_breakdown_times_a_hit_from_base_stat_: times a hit from base {stat} alone
vz_breakdown_family_the_marks_at_the_end: The marks at the end of a bar are one more average 5★ roll of that substat, added to your sheet.
vz_breakdown_hover_or_tap_a_column_to_re: Hover or tap a column to read it, and drag one with a grip to change its stat.
vz_breakdown_hover_or_tap_a_row_to_read_: Hover or tap a row to read it.
vz_crit_crit_rate_and_crit_damage_heatma: Crit rate and crit damage heatmap
vz_crit_move_to_the_best_split_of_this_b: Move to the best split of this budget

match.countPlural=one: {k} of {count} hit crit: {#strong}{multiplier}{/strong}, in {chance} of rotations.
match.countPlural=other: {k} of {count} hits crit: {#strong}{multiplier}{/strong}, in {chance} of rotations.

vz_crit_darkens_each_crit_rate_by_its_ch: Darkens each CRIT Rate by its chance of a whole rotation without a single crit
vz_crit_a_hit_that_doesn_t_crit_is_1: A hit that doesn’t crit is ×1.
vz_crit_the_curving_bands_show_how_much_: The curving bands show how much your damage would increase over many rotations.
vz_crit_the_solid_line_is_every_build_wi: The solid line is every build with your {cv} total crit value (CV): 2 × CRIT Rate + CRIT DMG, base crit stats included. Its ring marks that budget’s best split; press it to move there.
vz_crit_each_bar_is_a_number_of_crits_in: Each bar is a number of crits in one rotation. Hover or tap one to read it.

match.countPlural=other: On average {average} of {count} hits crit, and {chance} of rotations never crit.

vz_crit_on_average_59_4_of_60_hits_crit_: On average 59.4 of 60 hits crit, and <0.1% of rotations never crit.
